name: 28803 · Asheville, NC
findings: ZIP 28803 (Asheville) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28803 (Asheville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28803 (Asheville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
